com.sun.jmx.remote.protocol.iiop

类 IIOPProxyImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.jmx.remote.protocol.iiop.IIOPProxyImpl
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    IIOPProxy

    public class IIOPProxyImpl
extends Object
implements IIOPProxy
    An implementation of IIOPProxy that simply delegates to the appropriate RMI-IIOP and CORBA APIs.
